purpose: Materialize provenance-bound mechanism and target-property intersections before any language model may draft a research proposal.

trust_boundary.claim_acceptance: A source claim is usable for a decisive screen only when its exact locator and evidence artifact are recorded with a decisive read status.
trust_boundary.unknown_policy: Missing or unresolved evidence remains unknown and creates a property-resolution task; it is never coerced to false or treated as novelty.
trust_boundary.screen_scope: Applicability and bounded-negative decisions apply only to the named mechanism instance and never close an entire route by implication.
trust_boundary.authorization_boundary: Typed cells, generated seeds, and desk decisions authorize no experiment, target computation, route promotion, or security claim.

source_claims.citation: Faugere, Huot, Joux, Renault, and Vitse, EUROCRYPT 2014, Symmetrized Summation Polynomials.
source_claims.statement: A rational small-order torsion point can act coordinatewise on summation-polynomial variables; the relation-preserving subgroup can grow with the number of free variables.
source_claims.boundary: This is a mechanism and conditional complexity result for curves with the required rational torsion, not evidence that secp256k1 has that target property.

source_claims.citation: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, PKC 2016, Algebraic Approaches for the ECDLP over Prime Fields.
source_claims.statement: One faithful prime-field factor-base construction uses roots produced from a sufficiently large smooth-order subgroup of the multiplicative group of the base field.
source_claims.boundary: The construction supplies an applicability condition and generalized-root problem; it does not by itself establish an end-to-end advantage on secp256k1.

source_claims.citation: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, PKC 2016, auxiliary-curve construction.
source_claims.statement: For an arbitrary prime p, a second construction searches for an auxiliary curve over the same field whose order has a sufficiently large smooth factor, then uses a self-isogeny of that auxiliary curve to define the composed root map.
source_claims.boundary: The auxiliary curve is a priori unrelated to the ECDLP target curve beyond sharing the field. Search, map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total attack cost remain separate obligations.

source_claims.citation: Petit, Kosters, and Messeng, PKC 2016, partial cost analysis.
source_claims.statement: The source estimates decompositions per target by (deg L)^m divided by m! times p and uses (deg L)^m approximately m! times p as the balance point in its partial cost model.
source_claims.boundary: This is a heuristic relation-yield expression in a unit-cost model. It does not bound T(E,m,L), prove relation independence, or establish an end-to-end advantage.

source_claims.citation: Lean theorem secp256k1_no_nonzero_two_torsion.
source_claims.statement: Every rational secp256k1 point over the base field annihilated by multiplication by two is the identity point.
source_claims.boundary: This excludes direct rational two-torsion on secp256k1 over the base field only; it does not exclude auxiliary curves or extension fields.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic exact p-minus-one arithmetic certificate.
source_claims.statement: The independently replayed integer identity writes p-1 as 2 times 3 times 7 times 13441 times the 237-bit cofactor, so the displayed small-factor product is 564522.
source_claims.boundary: This certificate checks exact integer arithmetic, not cofactor primality or total relation-generation and Groebner cost.

source_claims.citation: Lean primality theorem for the 237-bit cofactor of secp256k1 p-1.
source_claims.statement: The 237-bit cofactor displayed in the p-1 factorization certificate is prime.
source_claims.boundary: Cofactor primality does not turn the certificate's arithmetic identity into a standalone kernel theorem and does not decide attack cost.

source_claims.citation: Lean theorem secp256k1_smooth_divisor_dvd_smooth_part.
source_claims.statement: Every divisor of secp256k1 p-1 whose prime divisors are at most 13441 divides 564522.
source_claims.boundary: This is arithmetic about divisors of the base-field value p-1 only; it is not an ECDLP or complexity result and says nothing about the group order, extension fields, or auxiliary curves.

source_claims.citation: SEC 2 version 2.0 secp256k1 domain parameters.
source_claims.statement: secp256k1 is defined over a 256-bit prime field and exposes its specified affine curve representation.
source_claims.boundary: Coordinate access is an opportunity surface, not evidence that a non-generic relation algorithm beats the generic square-root baseline.

source_claims.citation: Lean GLV endomorphism order-divides-three theorem.
source_claims.statement: The secp256k1 map sending x to beta times x and preserving y is an additive automorphism whose cube is the identity.
source_claims.boundary: This theorem establishes that the order divides three, not that the map is nontrivial. Existence of the automorphism alone gives no asymptotic discrete-log improvement and does not imply independent coordinatewise covariance.

source_claims.citation: Lean secp256k1 GLV nonidentity theorem.
source_claims.statement: The secp256k1 GLV additive automorphism is not the identity.
source_claims.boundary: Together with the separate cube-is-identity theorem this gives exact order three. Nontriviality alone gives no asymptotic discrete-log improvement.

source_claims.citation: Lean GLV-Semaev diagonal covariance and fixed-target transport package.
source_claims.statement: Lean proves diagonal S3 covariance, diagonal S4 invariance, and the exact transport of S4 fibers and point relations under the GLV map.
source_claims.boundary: The kernel package proves positive identities and transport laws; it does not prove exhaustive coordinatewise stabilizer classification.

source_claims.citation: Exact symbolic GLV-Semaev coordinate-scaling classification certificate.
source_claims.statement: The replayed exact certificate finds only the diagonal C3 coordinate-scaling covariance for S3 and S4 among the enumerated coordinatewise C3 action.
source_claims.boundary: This certificate-backed exhaustiveness result is not a Lean theorem and excludes neither non-scalar nor birational mechanisms.

source_claims.citation: Exact symbolic fixed-target GLV-Semaev classification certificate.
source_claims.statement: For nonzero affine target coordinate and the stated characteristic assumptions, only the identity coordinate scaling preserves the fixed-target S4 layer.
source_claims.boundary: The result concerns coordinatewise scalar C3 actions; it is not a Groebner lower bound and does not close faithful phase-preserving constructions.

source_claims.citation: Lean Semaev S3 and S4 relation-semantics package.
source_claims.statement: The formalized Semaev polynomials provide checked algebraic implications between point-sum relations and polynomial vanishing in the covered cases.
source_claims.boundary: The current Lean package is not an end-to-end prime-field index-calculus algorithm and does not supply relation probabilities or solver complexity.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic PKC smooth-subgroup M16 symbolic desk certificate.
source_claims.statement: Exact symbolic replay fixes the direct-S17, recursive-S3, source-factor-chain, quadratic-circuit, recovery-ceiling, and conditional matrix-template counts for M16, then returns a scoped blocker because solving, exceptional-fiber, independence, sparse-linear-algebra, and total-work terms remain unresolved.
source_claims.boundary: The certificate prices input structure only. Its dense capacities are not solver-memory bounds, its source yield is not a success probability, and the result authorizes no polynomial-system materialization, solver, hypothesis retention, experiment, or route promotion.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic PKC smooth-subgroup M16 affine semantic-bridge and recovery certificate.
source_claims.statement: Exact replay proves the fixed labeled affine left-fold S3 bridge only on the base-field-liftable stratum with nonidentity prefix sums, gives structural counterexamples to an unconditional fixed-topology affine substitution at the registered arity and source degree, and records a deterministic recovery contract plus an exact finite sign, duplicate, permutation, and final group-recovery replay for the control witness. Its future GLV coefficient rule is bound to the proved subgroup eigenvalue and full-group membership theorems.
source_claims.boundary: The certificate returns a scoped blocker: it does not prove a global direct-S17 versus recursive equivalence, complete the projective or exceptional-fiber classification, replay a full GLV-normalized source relation, determine relation yield or rank, price solving or sparse linear algebra, evaluate S17, authorize an experiment, retain a hypothesis, or promote a route.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic PKC smooth-subgroup M16 projective exceptional-fiber and recovery-domain certificate.
source_claims.statement: For the nonsingular curve y^2=x^3+7 over fields of characteristic not in {2,3,7}, exact replay proves the set-theoretic homogeneous projective S3 caterpillar is equivalent to signed-point semantics on the stated algebraic-closure and base-field lift domains, classifies the identity, tangent, rational two-torsion, duplicate, extension-only, and non-lift strata, and completes deterministic supplied-coordinate recovery plus raw and compressed secp256k1 GLV sign checks.
source_claims.boundary: Assurance is certificate_replayed, source_independence is not_established, and calibration is excluded_nonexperimental. The certificate returns a scoped blocker with the barrier narrowed but open: the direct S17 predicate is not frozen and no reverse theorem above S4 is present. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial while solving cost is unpriced. It claims no S17 expansion or evaluation, radicality, scheme equality, multiplicity comparison, relation yield or rank, solving or sparse-linear-algebra cost, experiment authorization, hypothesis retention, exact-target search, or route promotion.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic PKC smooth-subgroup M16 recursive projective S17 bridge certificate.
source_claims.statement: The certificate freezes the recursive projective S17 contract, including its base cases, degree recurrence, fixed-degree interpretation, and literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. Its coefficient unit is 1 in that definition, no primitive/content normalization is allowed, and projective rescaling follows the declared multidegree. It records the forward projective-tree algebraic argument and replays bounded S4/S5 forward/reverse fixtures, while the universal reverse projection above S4 remains unproved.
source_claims.boundary: Assurance is certificate_replayed, source_independence is not_established, and calibration is excluded_nonexperimental. The generic C16 forward implication is not computationally replayed or kernel checked; its algebraic argument is only recorded. The barrier narrowed but open: a kernel-checked fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem and a specialization-compatibility lemma for the recursive symbolic C_r construction, including output [1:0], are still required. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial; solving cost is unpriced, rank is unpriced, and yield is unpriced. The certificate claims no S17 expansion or evaluation, polynomial-system materialization, radicality, scheme equality, multiplicity comparison, solving or sparse-linear-algebra cost, hypothesis retention, exact-target search, or route promotion, and creates no experiment authorization.

source_claims.citation: Deterministic PKC smooth-subgroup M16 fixed-degree projective-resultant kernel-binding certificate.
source_claims.statement: Lean kernel checks at positive fixed formal degrees that the fixed-degree resultant vanishes exactly when the homogenized forms have a nonzero projective common-root pair, including coefficient-map and algebraic-closure reflection variants. The literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix is a reindexed transpose of the library matrix, its determinant equals the resultant with coefficient unit 1, and its end-to-end common-root corollary is kernel checked. Formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and output [1:0] are retained without primitive/content, monic, or actual-degree normalization.
source_claims.boundary: Assurance is kernel_bound_non_run_certificate, source_independence is not_established, and calibration is excluded_nonexperimental. The barrier is narrowed but open: the exact recursive frozen C_r specialization at formal degrees (2^(r-2),2), including coefficient unit 1, affine output, and [1:0], and the universal C16-to-C2 induction remain open_exact_blocker. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial; solving cost is unpriced, rank is unpriced, and yield is unpriced. The certificate claims no recursive C_r theorem, S17 expansion or evaluation, polynomial-system materialization, scheme or multiplicity result, solver or sparse-linear-algebra cost, hypothesis retention, exact-target search, experiment authorization, or route promotion; its retention disposition is zero_retention_success.

source_claims.citation: Yokoyama, Yasuda, Takahashi, and Kogure, Journal of Mathematical Cryptology 14(1), 2020.

locator.value: Naive random-V setup in Section 2; Assumption 7, Remark 8, Lemma 8, and Proposition 9 in Sections 3.4 and 4.1.2

source_claims.statement: For the naive random-factor-base point-decomposition ideal, Proposition 9 conditionally lower-bounds almost-every-target Groebner-basis cost by (m*d^(m-1))^(1-epsilon) field operations for efficient algorithms using S-polynomials.
source_claims.boundary: The result depends on Assumption 7 and the non-rigorous transfer in Remark 8, is a cost rather than solving-degree bound, and does not automatically apply to structured Petit, Amadori, or unread Kudo systems.

source_claims.citation: Amadori, Pintore, and Sala, On the Discrete Logarithm Problem for Prime-Field Elliptic Curves.

locator.value: Section 3; Section 3.2, p. 10 unnumbered T approximately T-prime assumption; Section 4

source_claims.statement: The source accumulates random points as its factor base and replaces repeated decompositions plus sparse linear algebra by one summation-polynomial system whose recovered point relation yields the discrete logarithm congruence.
source_claims.boundary: Its relative comparison with Petit assumes T(E,m,V) approximately T-prime(E,m,V); it explicitly does not claim work below p^(1/2), reports only 11-22-bit experiments, and leaves the single-system cost unresolved.

source_claims.citation: Yokota, Kudo, and Yasuda, WCC 2017, Practical Limit of Index Calculus Algorithms for ECDLP over Prime Fields.

locator.value: Section 1 final paragraph; Section 2.3; Sections 3.1-3.4, equations (4)-(8), Tables 1-2; Section 5

source_claims.statement: For m=2 and selected favorable primes with a power-of-two factor N approximately p^(1/2) dividing p-1, the exhaustive k=1 presentation has the lowest reported time in every row of Table 1, while Table 2 reports lower resultant or GCD times at 12.1, 14.1, and 16.0 bits; Groebner variants exhibit severe memory growth.
source_claims.boundary: The source explicitly makes no asymptotic claim. Its selected small-prime measurements do not price m=16 or S17, establish cryptographic scaling, or attack secp256k1.

source_claims.citation: Yokota, Kudo, and Yasuda, WCC 2017, p-plus-one trace extension.
source_claims.statement: The source constructs a factor-base coordinate set from N-th roots of unity in the quadratic extension and the field trace when p+1 has a large smooth factor, with its low-degree experiments specialized to m=2.
source_claims.boundary: This extension-field trace construction is not the PKC 2016 auxiliary elliptic curve and self-isogeny construction. Its 5.6-10.1-bit measurements do not resolve the auxiliary-curve property or its typed cell.

target_properties.label: Direct rational two-torsion
target_properties.statement: The secp256k1 base-field point group contains no nonidentity point of order dividing two.
target_properties.scope: Direct secp256k1 over the specified prime base field only.

target_properties.label: Maximum 13441-smooth divisor of p-1
target_properties.statement: The exact 13441-smooth divisor ceiling for secp256k1 p-1 is 564522.
target_properties.scope: Divisors of the secp256k1 base-field value p-1, with smoothness bound 13441.

target_properties.label: Nontrivial GLV order-three action
target_properties.statement: secp256k1 carries the nontrivial order-three GLV automorphism used by the structural route.
target_properties.scope: The secp256k1 point group and its affine coordinate representation.

target_properties.label: Prime-field coordinate representation
target_properties.statement: The target is a curve over the specified 256-bit prime field with accessible coordinate formulas.
target_properties.scope: Public secp256k1 domain parameters and classical non-generic analysis.

target_properties.label: PKC auxiliary-curve instance
target_properties.statement: No explicit auxiliary curve over the secp256k1 base field with the required smooth order factor and fully priced composed map is recorded yet.
target_properties.scope: The shared base field and the exact PKC 2016 auxiliary-curve construction; no isogeny to secp256k1 is required.

cost_quantities.label: Relation-preserving coordinatewise subgroup growth
cost_quantities.definition: The order of the coordinatewise curve-symmetry subgroup preserving the fixed-target relation, expressed as a function of relation arity.
cost_quantities.baseline: A subgroup whose order is bounded independently of arity supplies only bounded orbit compression unless another cost lever is proved.
cost_quantities.measurement: Derive the action on the point-sum relation, classify its preserving subgroup, and verify the formula independently.

cost_quantities.label: Faithful GLV phase-quotient solving cost
cost_quantities.definition: End-to-end relation-generation cost after retaining all relative GLV phase information, including quotient construction, recovery, excluded components, and solver work.
cost_quantities.baseline: Matched Semaev relation collection without the proposed quotient, with identical target, factor base, relation arity, and success criterion.
cost_quantities.measurement: Require an exact map and recovery algorithm, then compare preregistered scaling laws rather than one solver timing.

cost_quantities.label: Total prime-field relation-generation cost
cost_quantities.definition: Online and offline cost of obtaining enough independently validated full relations, including factor-base construction, polynomial solving, recovery, and linear algebra.
cost_quantities.baseline: The generic square-root attack and the matched plain Semaev pipeline must both be priced under the same threat model.
cost_quantities.measurement: Record scaling across field sizes with matched baselines and retain every preprocessing, memory, parallelism, and amortization term.

cost_quantities.label: Generalized root-finding and recovery cost
cost_quantities.definition: Cost of solving the composed-map fiber constraints and recovering valid factor-base points without hidden discarded components.
cost_quantities.baseline: Direct factor-base membership and relation recovery at the same arity and effective factor-base size.
cost_quantities.measurement: Price all roots, spurious fibers, recovery failures, preprocessing, and independent relation validation as field size grows.

cost_quantities.label: Semaev S17 system construction and solving cost
cost_quantities.definition: Total cost of constructing, representing, solving, and validating the relation system required by an arity-sixteen smooth-subgroup instantiation.
cost_quantities.baseline: The same success probability priced against generic square-root work and lower-arity prime-field relation pipelines.
cost_quantities.measurement: An exact symbolic size bound must precede any solver run; degree, monomial count, memory, and recovery are all included.

barriers.exact_scope: Replacing every free coordinate independently by its cube is not a faithful quotient of the fixed-target GLV-Semaev relation system.
reopening_conditions: Provide a different exact quotient with relative phase tags, an inverse recovery map, and a cost bridge not based on the closed independent-cube identification.

barriers.exact_scope: Processing a target together with its two GLV images is a finite target-batching factor and is not by itself an asymptotic relation-generation bridge.
reopening_conditions: Prove a distinct mechanism changing a cost quantity with field size or relation arity rather than relying only on the three target images.

barriers.exact_scope: The m-equals-four smooth-subgroup instance cannot obtain a factor base near size two-to-the-sixty-four from the small-factor part of secp256k1 p-minus-one.
reopening_conditions: Change the exact construction or arity and reprice the complete system; do not reinterpret this instance-level shortfall as route-wide inapplicability.

barriers.exact_scope: For nonsingular y^2=x^3+7 in characteristic not in {2,3,7}, the M16 input presentations and set-theoretic homogeneous projective S3 caterpillar semantics are exact, including identity, tangent, rational two-torsion, duplicate, extension-only, non-lift, topology, recovery, and GLV lift-sign strata. TASK-018 freezes the recursive projective S17 contract, including fixed degrees and the literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. TASK-019 kernel-checks the fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem, coefficient-map and algebraic-closure reflection variants, the literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix bridge with coefficient unit 1, and its end-to-end common-root corollary, while retaining formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. The barrier is narrowed but open only on the exact recursive frozen C_r specialization at formal degrees (2^(r-2),2), including coefficient unit 1, affine output, and [1:0], followed by the universal C16-to-C2 induction. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial while relation yield and rank, solving degree and fill-in, preprocessing, sparse linear algebra, and total solving cost remain unpriced.
reopening_conditions: Kernel-check the exact recursive frozen C_r specialization at formal degrees (2^(r-2),2), retaining coefficient unit 1, affine output, and [1:0], then prove the universal C16-to-C2 induction against the exact projective-tree predicate before any cost claim; after that, determine the usable relation-rank model and combine proved solving and sparse-linear-algebra costs with a matched generic baseline.

mechanisms.label: Naive independent coordinate cubes
mechanisms.scope: Fixed-target Semaev relation systems with every free x-coordinate replaced independently by its cube.
mechanisms.construction: Map each x_i to u_i equals x_i cubed and discard all relative GLV phase information.
mechanisms.relation_action: The map quotients a coordinatewise C3 power, while the exact relation admits only the diagonal C3 action.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: Proposed variable-domain compression by independent phase removal.

requires_all.rationale: The proposed coordinate cubes are motivated by the actual order-three GLV action.

mechanisms.boundary: This bounded negative does not close faithful phase-preserving, non-scalar, or birational GLV-Semaev mechanisms.

mechanisms.label: Faithful relative-phase GLV quotient
mechanisms.scope: A not-yet-specified quotient that retains enough relative GLV phase data to preserve and recover fixed-target Semaev relations.
mechanisms.construction: Use mixed diagonal invariants or explicit phase tags with a total recovery map instead of independent coordinate cubes.
mechanisms.relation_action: The construction must preserve the exact fixed-target relation and distinguish all phase combinations merged by the naive quotient.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: Unknown effect on solving degree, sparse support, mixed volume, recovery cost, or full relation cost.

requires_all.rationale: A faithful GLV quotient requires the proved order-three action but must add a new premise beyond it.

mechanisms.boundary: This is a parked desired-property record, not a mechanism. It cannot emit a seed until a new claim supplies an exact map, recovery semantics, and cost-changing bridge.

mechanisms.label: Direct rational two-torsion symmetrization
mechanisms.scope: Apply the published coordinatewise rational two-torsion translation mechanism directly to secp256k1 over its base field.
mechanisms.construction: Translate selected free points by one rational point of order two so the even-weight coordinate action preserves their sum.
mechanisms.relation_action: For an order-two point T, translating an even number of free variables adds an even multiple of T and preserves the fixed target.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: The relation-preserving subgroup would have order growing exponentially with relation arity.

requires_all.rationale: The direct published action requires a nonidentity rational point of order two on the target curve.

mechanisms.boundary: The failed target property excludes only direct base-field use; auxiliary curves, extension fields, and unrelated sum-compatible actions remain separate.

mechanisms.label: PKC smooth-subgroup construction at arity four
mechanisms.scope: Instantiate the PKC 2016 multiplicative smooth-subgroup factor-base construction at relation arity four for secp256k1.
mechanisms.construction: Build a faithful composed-map factor base from a smooth divisor of p-minus-one large enough for the arity-four relation target.
mechanisms.relation_action: The factor-base polynomial is compiled into the Semaev relation system and recovered through the published composed map.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: Proposed factor-base construction and generalized-root cost at arity four.

requires_all.rationale: An arity-four factor base at the secp256k1 scale requires size on the order of p to the one-fourth, approximately two to the sixty-four.
The same source's relation-yield balance requires the factor-base degree to reach the exact ceiling of (4! times p) to the one-fourth.

mechanisms.boundary: This is an arity-four screen only and must not be promoted to a claim that the entire smooth-subgroup or faithful Petit route is inapplicable.

mechanisms.label: PKC smooth-subgroup construction at arity sixteen
mechanisms.scope: Desk-cost analysis of the PKC 2016 smooth-subgroup construction at the first arity where the available divisor clears both the source's raw size condition and relation-yield balance.
mechanisms.construction: Use the available divisor 564522 of p-minus-one, which exceeds both the exact arity-sixteen raw threshold 65536 and balance threshold 445676, then price the complete map, relation system, and recovery path.
mechanisms.relation_action: The construction clears both arithmetic predicates only by moving to a high-arity Semaev relation. For nonsingular y^2=x^3+7 in characteristic not in {2,3,7}, TASK-017 fixes the exact set-theoretic projective S3-tree semantics, every named exceptional fiber, supplied-coordinate recovery, and GLV lift signs. TASK-018 freezes the recursive projective S17 contract with fixed degrees and the literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. TASK-019 kernel-checks the fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem, the literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix and determinant with coefficient unit 1, and the end-to-end common-root corollary while retaining formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. The remaining exact mechanism gap is the recursive frozen C_r specialization at formal degrees (2^(r-2),2), including affine output and [1:0], plus the universal C16-to-C2 induction.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: Total construction, representation, solving, and recovery cost of the corresponding S17 system.

requires_all.rationale: The available divisor exceeds the exact condition-one ceiling of p to the one-sixteenth.
The available divisor also exceeds the source-anchored relation-yield balance ceiling of (16! times p) to the one-sixteenth.

mechanisms.boundary: This open desk-cost cell has exact input presentations, an exact set-theoretic projective-tree bridge on the stated nonsingular characteristic domain, a complete named exceptional-fiber classification, deterministic control and secp256k1 GLV recovery checks, a frozen recursive projective S17 contract, and kernel-checked fixed-degree projective resultant plus literal Sylvester unit-one and end-to-end common-root theorems that retain formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. The exact recursive frozen C_r specialization and universal C16-to-C2 induction remain open, and the complete cost bridge is unproved. CQ-SEMAEV-S17-SYSTEM-COST remains partial; solving cost, rank, and yield remain unpriced. The scoped blocker has zero_retention_success and does not justify S17 expansion or evaluation, recursive-system materialization, a solver run, target computation, hypothesis retention, experiment authorization, or route promotion.

mechanisms.label: PKC auxiliary-curve construction
mechanisms.scope: Construct or rule out a fully priced auxiliary-curve instance over the secp256k1 base field under the exact PKC 2016 conditions.
mechanisms.construction: Find an auxiliary curve E0 over the same field whose order contains a B-smooth factor near p to the one-over-m scale; use the kernel self-isogeny on E0 to construct the composed root map L for target-curve factor-base coordinates.
mechanisms.relation_action: The original target curve remains the relation group. The auxiliary self-isogeny defines only the root set and low-degree decomposition of L; all recovered x-values must still lift to valid target-curve points and relations.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: Auxiliary-curve search, composed-map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total relation-generation cost.

requires_all.rationale: The construction cannot proceed until an explicit auxiliary-curve instance over the shared field is constructed and its complete cost is recorded.

mechanisms.boundary: The first output is a bounded arithmetic construction or no-instance record plus a complete precomputation estimate, not an ECDLP experiment.

mechanisms.label: End-to-end prime-field Semaev relation pipeline
mechanisms.scope: A future exact mechanism that changes the full cost of prime-field relation generation rather than only a polynomial presentation or one solver step.

mechanisms.relation_action: Every produced polynomial solution must recover to an independently validated point relation for the fixed target.
mechanisms.changed_quantity: End-to-end exponent or another formally defined total-cost quantity relative to the generic square-root baseline.

mechanisms.boundary: This is a parked desired-property record, not a mechanism. A prose idea, solver benchmark, or lower polynomial degree cannot emit a seed without the complete cost and recovery bridge.
